mapper.insert: insert into order_blind_box(order_id, seller_address, buyer_address, goods_id, sku_id, ct_id, token_id, tx_hash, reward_sku_id, reward_token_id, reward_tx_hash, reward_tx_note, reward_tx_status, order_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{sellerAddress}, #{buyerAddress}, #{goodsId}, #{skuId}, #{ctId}, #{tokenId}, #{txHash}, #{rewardSkuId}, #{rewardTokenId}, #{rewardTxHash}, #{rewardTxNote}, #{rewardTxStatus}, #{orderTime})
mapper.select: select * from order_blind_box where reward_tx_status = #{txStatus} limit 50
